from solution import tree_summary
import pytest

def test_empty_mapping():
    assert tree_summary({}) == '(empty tree)'

def test_single_item():
    assert tree_summary({'a': 'x'}) == 'a  (1 chars)'

def test_multiple_items_within_limit():
    result = tree_summary({f'k{i}': 'x' for i in range(10)})
    lines = result.split('\n')
    assert len(lines) == 10
    assert lines[0] == 'k0  (1 chars)'
    assert lines[9] == 'k9  (1 chars)'

def test_items_exceed_limit():
    state = {f'k{i}': 'x' for i in range(50)}
    result = tree_summary(state, limit=40)
    lines = result.split('\n')
    assert len(lines) == 42
    assert lines[0] == 'k0  (1 chars)'
    assert lines[39] == 'k39  (1 chars)'
    assert lines[40] == '... and 10 more file(s)'

def test_items_equal_limit():
    state = {f'k{i}': 'x' for i in range(40)}
    result = tree_summary(state, limit=40)
    lines = result.split('\n')
    assert len(lines) == 40
    assert lines[0] == 'k0  (1 chars)'
    assert lines[39] == 'k39  (1 chars)'
    assert '... and ' not in result

def test_special_characters_in_keys():
